gitCommit.subject: feat(TSK-4820): Admin user management list and signup report (#1647)
gitCommit.body:
feat(TSK-4820): Admin user management list and signup report (#1647)

* fix(TSK-4820): set preference language on all registration paths

Persist preferenceLanguage for OAuth and guest upgrades via registration_locale cookie and adapter createUser, align default fallback with i18n (JA_JP), and add unit/integration coverage.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): enhance admin user list filters and signup report

Add invitation code and email verification filters, quick links to generated
images/videos, preferred-language distribution on the signup report, and
wrap filter controls when the form overflows.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* fix(TSK-4820): gate generated media actions and azure export download

Only show view-generated actions to users with write-imageManagement, and
switch the export download CTA to the azure LoadingButton.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* fix(TSK-4820): avoid per-row permission fetch in user list

Compute write-imageManagement once on the server and pass it down to UserActions
to prevent N permission requests. Also remove redundant UserSignupStats type re-export.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): expand admin user signup report analytics

Add overall/cohort metrics for active users, email verification, retention,
and preference language donuts. Rework invitation code stats with coin-pool
grouped donut, accordion legend, and shared count/percentage styling.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): refine admin signup report sections and generation stats

Add scoped overall/cohort generation metrics including text generation.
Refactor generation and invitation UI with in-card titles, scope pills,
and tooltip ordering. Show coin pool count in invitation summary; move
scope toggle into filter bar.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): refine admin signup report model distribution and stats helpers

Group model usage by Gemini/GPT/ComfyUI with donut chart UI aligned to invitation codes; move signup stats pure helpers out of use server module; filter completed text generations; polish section tooltips and scope pills.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): expand admin signup report AI tool usage metrics

Add AI tool usage summary (unique users vs category visit totals), output-type and model-group donuts with SlidingTabs metric toggle, per-type user penetration percentages, and four-locale tooltips.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): add chart guide and AI insights to signup report

Help admins interpret metrics with an accordion guide and on-demand Gemini analysis for the active date range and scope.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* fix(TSK-4820): harden signup report AI insights and retention UX

Add copy-analysis control, cohort-only retention hint under overall scope, analyze API validation, payload/generation tests, and product doc updates.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4820): unify signup report metric cards and loading UX

Show population-based ratios on summary cards, simplify AI tool user visits,
add full-page loading while fetching stats, model-section tooltips, and sync i18n/docs/tests.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* fix(TSK-4820): raise donut chart tooltip above center labels

Stack Recharts layer above z-0 center overlay so hover tooltips are not covered.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
